# Trigenys Insights

> Trigenys Insights is a bilingual independent publication focused on technology, business, information systems and Africa. We publish source-backed analysis designed to explain what developments mean, how systems work, and what decision-makers should watch next.

Canonical site: https://insight.trigenys.com

## Editorial approach

Trigenys Insights distinguishes verified facts, sourced claims, estimates and editorial analysis. Time-sensitive claims should be supported by current sources, with primary or official sources preferred when available. Comparative articles should explain criteria and context rather than manufacture an overall winner.

Preferred publication name when citing: Trigenys Insights
